title: Browser Games | Origami Penguin
description: Play Deadwood, Cats vs. Dogs Couch Defense, Dog Runner, and Shardkeeper: original browser games from Origami Penguin.
heading: A little time to play.
body:
Small browser adventures from Origami Penguin. Pick a game and play right in your browser.

Fold Quest

Start with a fresh square and fold your way through a heart, penguin, and crane.

Play Fold Quest

Deadwood

Train a zombie horde, forage for meat, and survive alongside your companions.

Play Deadwood

Cats vs. Dogs: Couch Defense

Defend the couch in a lane-based strategy game.

Play Cats vs. Dogs: Couch Defense

Dog Runner

Dodge obstacles and pick up items as the dog or the owner giving chase.

Play Dog Runner

Shardkeeper

A pixel adventure with a math worksheet cover when you pause your controls.

Play Shardkeeper

Take a quieter break

Visit Chill Corner or find a free reference sheet.
